feed_summary: A $300,000 award went to a pre-launch flaw that exposed conversations and tokens on internal Muse test VMs used by Meta staff. The post Meta Shares Top Muse Bug Bounty Findings as Payouts Reach $1.2 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek .
title: Meta Shares Top Muse Bug Bounty Findings as Payouts Reach $1.2 Million
